visualReview.notes: Four integral surviving ancient entrance piers on their four mapped footprints: low broad tapered rubble bodies, fractured caps and a taller narrow surviving remnant connected into the eastern pier. Three real open passages retain lawn and paths. Ordinary official entrance picture and retained aerial context plus standard PMTiles/Mapzen guide one continuous author/inspect pass. No invented intact arches, lintels, roof or paved platform. Main villa/baths, Triclinium and Xystus load together with the entrance; the two latrines remain unapproved procedural context.

Canonical metric UVs, sRGB-to-linear tint and baked graph means for skyline; three textured draws/one skyline. No embedded image, private atlas or new graph. Separate vertex streams and equal CPU/GPU geometry bytes. The four-model site uses nine existing shared graphs, each read once. Flat portable/shared/synthetic planes intersect some grade-specific bases or expose mask patches; unchanged native terrain supplies ground-fit evidence.

limitations: Four integral surviving monumental entrance piers only, placed on their four actual mapped footprints. Model low broad irregular rubble bodies, fractured tops and a taller narrow eastern wall remnant from the ordinary official entrance photograph. Three passages, lawn and paths remain open. No intact triumphal arches, reconstructed lintels, entrance roof or invented paved platform. Main villa/baths, Triclinium, Xystus and two latrines remain independent. Unmapped surrounding courtyard columns/walls, signage and site furniture remain context.
